import_time_side_effect_lineage.why: Works in tests, fails in workers.
import_time_side_effect_lineage.signal: Module-scope side-effect statements (I/O, connect, signal, atexit, thread start) later moved into a function, or fix message import|circular|fork|worker|startup with sibling modules keeping the pattern; weight by importer count.
import_time_side_effect_lineage.packet: Statements with commits, importers, fix diff.
import_time_side_effect_lineage.question: Safe initialisation point?
import_time_side_effect_lineage.example: Redis connect at import moved to get_client().

ingress_annotation_semantics_change.name: Ingress annotation and path-type semantic change
ingress_annotation_semantics_change.label: AntiPattern
ingress_annotation_semantics_change.pitfall: Controller annotations and pathType differ across versions.
ingress_annotation_semantics_change.signal: Text diff on controller-prefixed annotations, rewrite-target, use-regex, pathType, ingressClassName, auth-url, allowlist in Ingress files/chart templates; controller prefix change or fix within 20 commits.
ingress_annotation_semantics_change.question: Which controller semantics does it rely on?

integer_width_downcast_fix.name: Integer width or overflow fix lineage
integer_width_downcast_fix.label: AntiPattern
integer_width_downcast_fix.signal: Widening on id/*_id column or overflow-keyword message; siblings via <table>_id name pattern with narrower type in SQL/migration DDL only.
integer_width_downcast_fix.question: Which referencing columns remain narrow?
integer_width_downcast_fix.noise: Lookup tables, enum-bounded, no inbound refs.

isolation_or_autocommit_change.name: Isolation level or autocommit setting changed
isolation_or_autocommit_change.label: Pattern
isolation_or_autocommit_change.pitfall: Isolation changes cause serialization failures or lost updates.
isolation_or_autocommit_change.signal: Value change in isolation_level, ISOLATION LEVEL, ATOMIC_REQUESTS, autocommit, default_transaction_isolation; lock clauses (FOR UPDATE, SKIP LOCKED) only when changed in commit with deadlock|lost update|race message or file with >=3 lock events.
isolation_or_autocommit_change.question: What anomaly motivated the level?
isolation_or_autocommit_change.example: READ COMMITTED to SERIALIZABLE adds 40001 retry loop.

flag_added_as_rollback_valve.name: Kill switch introduced right after an incident
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.label: Pattern
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.pitfall: A toggle added after a revert/fix marks a failure-prone area.
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.signal: Within 14 days after a fix/revert R touching the same files, a commit adds new bool env/config/flag read with safe default or kill switch|disable via|safe mode message; skip bulk/initial commits.
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.packet: Flag diff, preceding revert/fix, guarded code.
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.question: What incident does it guard?
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.noise: Exclude initial feature flags, test toggles.
flag_added_as_rollback_valve.example: New policy path not behind a flag, not stageable.

float_money_or_rounding_change.name: Money/decimal type or rounding mode changed
float_money_or_rounding_change.label: AntiPattern
float_money_or_rounding_change.pitfall: Money fields switch types or rounding.
float_money_or_rounding_change.signal: Type/scale/rounding-mode token change (Float->Decimal, NUMERIC(p,s), ROUND_HALF_*, RoundingMode) on money-named identifiers, or fix message penny|cent|rounding|reconcil; drop plain round()/toFixed.
float_money_or_rounding_change.packet: Old/new lines, schema, sibling money fields.
float_money_or_rounding_change.question: What numeric contract does the field have?
float_money_or_rounding_change.example: quantize HALF_EVEN vs NUMERIC(10,2) and float export.

pii_field_without_erasure_path.name: Personal-data field added with no erasure path
pii_field_without_erasure_path.label: Pattern
pii_field_without_erasure_path.pitfall: New PII column not added to erasure/export routine.
pii_field_without_erasure_path.signal: Erasure routine exists at HEAD, lists columns/tables explicitly, and history shows it was edited when earlier PII fields were added but not for the new PII-named column (schema/model files only).
pii_field_without_erasure_path.question: Does the routine cover the field?

preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.name: Pre-fork with import-time connections or threads
preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.label: Pattern
preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.pitfall: Resources created before fork are shared or dead in children.
preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.signal: Trigger: preload/prefork config change or fix adding post_fork|register_at_fork|dispose|lazy init; import-time resource list as evidence only.
preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.packet: Preload change, import-time resources, fix commits.
preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.question: Which resources must be created post-fork?
preload_app_fork_unsafe_init.example: preload_app=True; workers hang on DB pool from master.

environment_branching_in_code.name: Production-only code paths via environment checks
environment_branching_in_code.label: AntiPattern
environment_branching_in_code.pitfall: Branches on env name create paths tests never run.
environment_branching_in_code.signal: env/NODE_ENV/APP_ENV compared to prod names; guarded block >=10 lines with no mapped tests or with fix commits on guarded lines; exclude logging, DEBUG tooling, default selection.
environment_branching_in_code.question: What behaviour exists only in production?

relative_churn_spike.name: Relative churn spike (near-rewrite) in a file
relative_churn_spike.label: AntiPattern
relative_churn_spike.pitfall: A file rewritten >50% in a window is unstable and may lose invariants.
relative_churn_spike.signal: 90-day window: deleted lines >=50% of prior size, >=2 non-bulk commits by >=2 authors, churn >=3x median, later fix within 60 days; exclude files created in window.
relative_churn_spike.packet: Commit list, removed comments/guards, later fixes.
relative_churn_spike.question: Are prior constraints still honoured?
relative_churn_spike.noise: Exclude generated, lockfile, fixtures, i18n, <40 LOC.
relative_churn_spike.example: Relative churn predicted Windows Server 2003 defect density.

clone_late_propagation.name: Same fix replayed in a clone months later
clone_late_propagation.label: Pattern
clone_late_propagation.pitfall: A fix lands in one clone and months later is replayed in a sibling, exposing untracked coupling.
clone_late_propagation.why: History-verified hidden coupling with no import/call link.
clone_late_propagation.signal: Inverted index of shingled normalised hunk fingerprints weighted by IDF; commit pairs 14-365d apart sharing >=3 rare lines (>=4 changed), different files/dirs, co-change Jaccard <0.2, not already co-change candidates or sibling-divergence packets.
clone_late_propagation.packet: Aligned diffs, messages, gap, authors, clusters.
clone_late_propagation.question: Must every change to A be mirrored to B?
clone_late_propagation.noise: Skip bulk, version bumps, lockfiles, license headers, generated, import-only diffs.
clone_late_propagation.example: Date-parsing fix in v1 handlers reappears 4 months later in internal handlers.

parameter_accretion.name: Signature that keeps gaining parameters or boolean flags
parameter_accretion.label: AntiPattern
parameter_accretion.pitfall: Optional params and mode flags accrete per caller variant.
parameter_accretion.signal: Diary signatures: >=2 added params that are bool or default None/False, in-degree >=5, >=1 fix-class commit, params grew >=4 across >=3 commits.
parameter_accretion.packet: Signature timeline, call samples, guarded bodies, tests.
parameter_accretion.question: Which combinations are valid?
parameter_accretion.noise: Skip dataclass/config constructors, CLI binders, generated.
parameter_accretion.example: export(report, fmt, legacy=False, inline=True, strict=False) after 9 edits.

signing_key_session_format_change.name: Signing key / session serializer / token claims changed
signing_key_session_format_change.label: AntiPattern
signing_key_session_format_change.pitfall: Changing signing material or claims invalidates sessions and breaks rolling deploys.
signing_key_session_format_change.signal: SECRET_KEY(_FALLBACKS), SESSION_SERIALIZER/ENGINE, JWT algorithm/issuer/audience settings, or claim-key rename inside sign/verify call; no generic salt/aud/iss; never emit values.
signing_key_session_format_change.question: What artefacts does it invalidate?
signing_key_session_format_change.example: JWT audience renamed; old tokens fail.

soft_delete_filter_sibling_drift.name: Soft-delete predicate missing in sibling queries
soft_delete_filter_sibling_drift.label: Pattern
soft_delete_filter_sibling_drift.why: Deleted data leaks into counts and exports.
soft_delete_filter_sibling_drift.signal: Primary: commit adds soft-delete predicate to existing query; sibling ratio for same model via literal model/table names within one language as evidence; exclude default-scope models.
soft_delete_filter_sibling_drift.question: Intentional or leak?

hook_and_init_ordering_change.name: Startup/deploy ordering primitives edited
hook_and_init_ordering_change.label: Pattern
hook_and_init_ordering_change.pitfall: Hook weights, sync waves, depends_on conditions race.
hook_and_init_ordering_change.signal: Numeric hook-weight/sync-wave change, depends_on condition changed/removed, wait-for script added/removed, or >=3 commits on these lines in 90 days; deploy-path files only.
hook_and_init_ordering_change.packet: Ordering lines, mini DAG, failure messages.
hook_and_init_ordering_change.question: What order is required?
hook_and_init_ordering_change.noise: Test/CI compose, plain depends_on and nc -z.
hook_and_init_ordering_change.example: service_healthy dropped; API starts before Postgres.

strictness_relaxation.name: Strictness relaxed or suppressed in bulk
strictness_relaxation.label: Pattern
strictness_relaxation.pitfall: strict flags off and suppression waves move defects to runtime.
strictness_relaxation.signal: (a) config loosening (tsconfig strict, mypy, eslint, -Werror) via before/after parse or added exclude/override; (b) one commit adding >=20 suppression markers or any security rule (B1xx, S###, nosec). Drop per-symbol rule.
strictness_relaxation.question: Which modules are exempt?
strictness_relaxation.noise: Initial config, vendored, tests, style rules.
strictness_relaxation.example: strictNullChecks false with an exclude list that never shrank.

test_erosion_changepoint.name: Test co-evolution ratio collapsing over time in a module
test_erosion_changepoint.label: AntiPattern
test_erosion_changepoint.pitfall: Gradual test erosion: the share of production changes accompanied by test changes falls with no single commit to point at.
test_erosion_changepoint.why: Co-evolution phases (synchronous, test-driven, lagging, hibernation) are visible only in time series (Zaidman et al.); a changepoint tells where test investment stopped and the fixes after it are the best retro-test targets.
test_erosion_changepoint.signal: Per top-level module and quarter, share of non-bulk production commits that edit any test file in the same module or the mirrored test directory. Emit when the share falls by at least 0.3 between consecutive 4-quarter windows, each with at least 10 commits, and churn continues. Evidence: the quarterly table, 3 sample commits either side, post-drop fix commits with no test edit, and symbols with at least 2 post-drop fixes and test_gap. Exclude changes in test layout (test files renamed or moved) and docs or config-only churn.
test_erosion_changepoint.packet: Quarterly table; changepoint quarter; sample commits before and after; active authors; post-drop fixes and missing tests; current test_gap symbols.
test_erosion_changepoint.question: What caused the drop (ownership, rewrite, CI no longer running tests, tests moved)? Which symbols changed since are most worth retro-testing and what should they assert?
test_erosion_changepoint.noise: Tests moved to another directory (rename lineage); <10 commits per window; docs/config-only churn; bulk commits.
test_erosion_changepoint.example: billing/ fell from 71% to 18% same-commit test edits after Q2 2024 when CI was changed to run only tests/unit; 6 fixes landed with no tests. Target the three symbols with 2+ fixes.
sources: Pinto, Sung, Xie and Marinov, FSE 2012

timezone_encoding_change.name: Timezone, charset or collation default changed
timezone_encoding_change.label: Pattern
timezone_encoding_change.why: Silent data shifts and duplicate keys.
timezone_encoding_change.signal: Diffs to settings/config/migrations changing TIME_ZONE, USE_TZ, charset, collation, LANG/LC_ALL; CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET, ALTER DATABASE COLLATE, timestamp to timestamptz; later tz/DST/mojibake fix as boost; no generic app-code hits.
timezone_encoding_change.question: What data is reinterpreted?

cache_unbounded_growth_fix.name: Unbounded cache growth and its eviction fix
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.label: AntiPattern
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.pitfall: Memo dicts and caches without size/TTL grow until OOM.
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.why: Eviction parameters encode a memory budget.
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.signal: Fix commit (leak|OOM|unbounded|evict) adding maxsize|ttl|WeakValueDictionary|TTLCache; attach container memory-limit diffs within +/-30 days; HEAD lru_cache(maxsize=None) only as boost.
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.packet: Fix diff, cardinality hints, memory limit history.
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.question: What is the key space and bound?
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.noise: Skip small-enum keys, arg-less functions, CLIs.
cache_unbounded_growth_fix.example: Per-key map leak fixed with TTLCache.

unbounded_query_pagination_fix.name: Unbounded result set later bounded
unbounded_query_pagination_fix.label: Pattern
unbounded_query_pagination_fix.pitfall: Endpoints load whole tables and fail as data grows.
unbounded_query_pagination_fix.why: The bound is a hidden constraint on callers.
unbounded_query_pagination_fix.signal: Fix-classified (perf or oom|timeout|slow|large message) commit adds bound token (paginate, page_size, yield_per, cursor) to a function with an unbounded query pre-fix; siblings as short list only.
unbounded_query_pagination_fix.question: What size assumption broke?

benign_gap_not_worth_testing.name: Uncovered but not worth testing (negative insight)
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.label: Pattern
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.pitfall: Coverage-driven effort spent on dead, generated, trivial or logging-only code.
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.why: Coverage finds untested code, not a target (Marick; Fowler); unused code costs maintenance so deletion often beats testing (Eder 2012); recording 'don't chase this' prevents re-proposal.
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.signal: Per directory, take uncovered symbols (no mapped or measured test) that satisfy a deterministic benign class: generated header or pb2/.min glob, body <=3 lines with no branch, __repr__/__str__/dataclass, body only logging or print calls, or abstract/NotImplementedError stubs. Treat 'dead' as benign only if fan_in=0 AND not exported or registered (decorator, pyproject scripts, package.json bin, __all__) AND no commit touching it in 12+ months. Exclude symbols with fix lineage, public API, string-contract participation or security findings. Emit a candidate only when the classes cover >=5 symbols or >=15% of uncovered lines in the directory.
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.packet: Uncovered symbols with class label and evidence; dynamic-use exceptions (string-registered, reflection, plugin entry points); share of uncovered total.
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.question: Confirm each is low value or flag the one with hidden use. Delete, exclude from coverage (omit/pragma) or ignore? How much of the gap does this explain?
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.noise: Never benign: symbols with fix history, public API, string-contract participation or security findings.
benign_gap_not_worth_testing.example: vendor pb2 file and 40 __repr__ methods are 38% of uncovered lines; exclude from coverage.
sources: Marick, How to Misuse Code Coverage, 1999
Yuan, Park, Zhou, Logging practices, ICSE 2012

unit_change_without_callers.name: Unit of a constant/key changed without all consumers
unit_change_without_callers.label: AntiPattern
unit_change_without_callers.pitfall: Units change while name stays (ms/s, bytes/KB).
unit_change_without_callers.signal: (1) unit-suffix rename lineage (_ms/_sec/_bytes); (2) named constant/default/config literal changed by ratio 1000/60/1024; require >=2 consumers via CALLS/string contracts; drop conversion-literal heuristic.
unit_change_without_callers.packet: Rename/literal diff, callers' literals, config values.
unit_change_without_callers.question: Do callers still use the old unit?
unit_change_without_callers.example: timeout_ms renamed timeout seconds; callers pass 5000.

max_requests_leak_mask_and_herd.packet: Knob diff, leak trail, later real fix.
max_requests_leak_mask_and_herd.question: What would removal resurface?

proxy_pass_uri_trailing_slash.name: proxy_pass/rewrite trailing-slash semantics toggled
proxy_pass_uri_trailing_slash.label: Pattern
proxy_pass_uri_trailing_slash.pitfall: Trailing slash changes upstream URI mapping.
proxy_pass_uri_trailing_slash.signal: Removed/added proxy_pass/rewrite/StripPrefix lines equal after stripping trailing slash, or toggle reverting within 20 commits.
proxy_pass_uri_trailing_slash.question: What URL mapping does final form encode?
